product.name: Monoprice 4K High Speed HDMI Cable - 4K@24Hz 10.2Gbps CL2 In-Wall Rated Active 75ft Black
product.description: Monoprice's Ultra Series Active High Speed HDMI® Cable features the next generation of active HDMI cable technology. It delivers 10.2 Gbps bandwidth and it supports Ultra HD HDMI video transmissions with video resolutions up to 4K@24Hz with YUV 4:2:0 chroma sampling.
